title: Example 172: a retry route that dead-letters a delivery out of attempts twice, refuted by the effect trace
description: build.py runs example 172 end to end (foundations O3, the rest, step 2): the refactor of example 170 with an early dead letter for a delivery out of attempts that does not return, so the route dead-letters it again at the end. The answer is unchanged and the tests pass; jvmcontract effects must refute the send trace in exact order with a witness replayed on a JVM. Inline on 2026-11-07: refuted at status=0, idempotent=false, attempts=5 (one dead letter against the same dead letter twice).
expected: verdict violation, matchesExpected true; one counterexample with one dead-letter send before and two identical ones after; replay by jvm

resources.notes: build.py compiles two copies of the deliveries app with Crosscut's kernels (a few seconds each) and runs jvmcontract effects twice, under a second each; the release build of jvmcontract, if the runner has none, is most of the time
